datamodel:
// Institutional Email Intelligence — Canonical Domain Model
// PostgreSQL (Supabase-ready). JSON fields stored as String (serialized in app
// layer) for cross-DB compatibility; Float for confidence values.
// To deploy to Supabase: change provider to "postgresql" and set DATABASE_URL
// to your Supabase connection string (see .env.example).

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

generator client_py {
  provider = "prisma-client-py"
  output   = "../backend/.prisma"
}

datasource db {
  provider  = "postgresql"
  url       = env("DATABASE_URL")
  directUrl = env("DIRECT_URL")
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Users & Accounts
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

model User {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  supabaseId String?  @unique // Supabase auth user id
  email      String   @unique
  name       String?
  avatarUrl  String?
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt  DateTime @updatedAt

  accounts               AccountConnection[]
  assistantConversations AssistantConversation[]
  auditEvents            AuditEvent[]
}

model AccountConnection {
  id                String    @id @default(cuid())
  userId            String // NOT unique — one user can have many Google accounts
  provider          String    @default("google")
  providerAccountId String
  emailAddress      String
  displayName       String?
  accessToken       String? // encrypted OAuth access token
  refreshToken      String? // encrypted OAuth refresh token
  tokenExpiresAt    DateTime?
  status            String    @default("active") // active | syncing | error | disconnected
  createdAt         DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt         DateTime  @updatedAt

  user              User                     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  syncState         SyncState?
  threads           Thread[]
  senders           Sender[]
  categories        Category[]
  emails            Email[]
  rules             Rule[]
  notifications     Notification[]
  deadlines         Deadline[]
  actionItems       ActionItem[]
  assistantConvs    AssistantConversation[]
  auditEvents       AuditEvent[]
  assistantActions  AssistantAction[]
  notificationPrefs NotificationPreference[]

  @@unique([provider, providerAccountId])
  @@index([userId])
}

model SyncState {
  id             String    @id @default(cuid())
  accountId      String    @unique
  gmailHistoryId String?
  lastSyncedAt   DateTime?
  syncStatus     String    @default("idle") // idle | syncing | error | success
  errorCode      String?
  errorMessage   String?
  retryCount     Int       @default(0)
  updatedAt      DateTime  @updatedAt

  account AccountConnection @relation(fields: [accountId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Threads, Senders, Categories
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

model Thread {
  id               String    @id @default(cuid())
  accountId        String
  providerThreadId String
  subject          String?
  lastMessageAt    DateTime?
  conversationId   String?
  createdAt        DateTime  @default(now())

  account      AccountConnection @relation(fields: [accountId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  emails       Email[]
  conversation Conversation?     @relation(fields: [conversationId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@unique([accountId, providerThreadId])
  @@index([accountId, lastMessageAt])
  @@index([conversationId])
}

model Sender {
  id           String    @id @default(cuid())
  accountId    String
  senderEmail  String
  senderName   String?
  domain       String?
  firstSeenAt  DateTime?
  lastSeenAt   DateTime?
  messageCount Int       @default(0)
  discovered   Boolean   @default(true)
  ruleStatus   String    @default("none") // none | has_rule | ignored
  createdAt    DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime  @updatedAt

  account AccountConnection @relation(fields: [accountId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  emails  Email[]

  @@unique([accountId, senderEmail])
  @@index([accountId, lastSeenAt])
}

model Category {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  accountId     String
  name          String
  description   String?
  systemDefault Boolean  @default(false)
  sortOrder     Int      @default(0)
  color         String   @default("slate")
  icon          String   @default("folder")
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime @updatedAt

  account           AccountConnection        @relation(fields: [accountId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  memberships       CategoryMembership[]
  notifications     Notification[]
  deadlines         Deadline[]
  notificationPrefs NotificationPreference[]

  @@unique([accountId, name])
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Emails
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

model Email {
  id                       String    @id @default(cuid())
  accountId                String
  threadId                 String?
  providerMessageId        String
  providerThreadId         String?
  senderId                 String?
  fromName                 String?
  fromEmail                String
  toRecipients             String    @default("[]") // JSON array
  ccRecipients             String    @default("[]")
  bccRecipients            String    @default("[]")
  subject                  String?
  snippet                  String?
  bodyText                 String?
  bodyHtmlSanitized        String?
  receivedAt               DateTime?
  isRead                   Boolean   @default(false)
  isStarred                Boolean   @default(false)
  isImportant              Boolean   @default(false)
  isSpam                   Boolean   @default(false)
  isDraft                  Boolean   @default(false)
  isSent                   Boolean   @default(false)
  isArchived               Boolean   @default(false)
  hasAttachment            Boolean   @default(false)
  snoozedUntil             DateTime? // when set + future, hidden from default inbox; null = not snoozed
  labels                   String    @default("[]") // JSON array
  extractedLinks           String    @default("[]") // JSON array
  classificationSource     String? // manual_rule | user_override | sender_rule | ai | system_default
  classificationConfidence Float?
  createdAt                DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt                DateTime  @updatedAt

  account         AccountConnection      @relation(fields: [accountId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  thread          Thread?                @relation(fields: [threadId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  sender          Sender?                @relation(fields: [senderId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  attachments     EmailAttachment[]
  memberships     CategoryMembership[]
  deadlines       Deadline[]
  actionItems     ActionItem[]
  classifications ClassificationResult[]
  notifications   Notification[]

  @@unique([accountId, providerMessageId])
  @@index([accountId, receivedAt])
  @@index([accountId, isRead])
  @@index([accountId, senderId])
  @@index([accountId, snoozedUntil])
}

model EmailAttachment {
  id                   String  @id @default(cuid())
  emailId              String
  providerAttachmentId String
  filename             String
  mimeType             String
  size                 Int
  previewable          Boolean @default(false)

  email Email @relation(fields: [emailId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
}

model CategoryMembership {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  emailId    String
  categoryId String
  source     String // manual_rule | user_override | sender_rule | ai | system_default
  confidence Float?
  assignedAt DateTime @default(now())

  email    Email    @relation(fields: [emailId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  category Category @relation(fields: [categoryId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([categoryId])
}

model ClassificationResult {
  id               String   @id @default(cuid())
  emailId          String
  source           String
  categoryId       String?
  confidence       Float?
  rationaleSummary String?
  createdAt        DateTime @default(now())

  email Email @relation(fields: [emailId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Rules & Overrides
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

model Rule {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  accountId  String
  name       String
  expression String // JSON: condition tree
  actions    String // JSON: action list
  priority   Int      @default(100)
  enabled    Boolean  @default(true)
  createdBy  String   @default("user") // user | ai | system
  hitCount   Int      @default(0)
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt  DateTime @updatedAt

  account  AccountConnection @relation(fields: [accountId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  versions RuleVersion[]

  @@index([accountId, priority])
}

model RuleVersion {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  ruleId     String
  version    Int
  expression String
  actions    String
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())

  rule Rule @relation(fields: [ruleId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([ruleId, version])
}

model UserOverride {
  id           String   @id @default(cuid())
  accountId    String
  emailId      String?
  senderId     String?
  categoryId   String?
  overrideType String
  payload      String // JSON
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([accountId])
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Deadlines, Action Items, Notifications
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

model Deadline {
  id         String    @id @default(cuid())
  accountId  String
  emailId    String?
  categoryId String?
  title      String
  dueAt      DateTime?
  confidence Float?
  status     String    @default("open") // open | done | missed
  createdAt  DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt  DateTime  @updatedAt

  account  AccountConnection @relation(fields: [accountId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  email    Email?            @relation(fields: [emailId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  category Category?         @relation(fields: [categoryId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@index([accountId, dueAt])
}

model ActionItem {
  id        String    @id @default(cuid())
  accountId String
  emailId   String?
  title     String
  status    String    @default("open") // open | done
  dueAt     DateTime?
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())

  account AccountConnection @relation(fields: [accountId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  email   Email?            @relation(fields: [emailId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@index([accountId, status])
}

model Notification {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  accountId  String
  emailId    String?
  categoryId String?
  title      String
  body       String?
  importance String   @default("normal") // normal | important | urgent
  isRead     Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())

  account  AccountConnection @relation(fields: [accountId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  email    Email?            @relation(fields: [emailId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  category Category?         @relation(fields: [categoryId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@index([accountId, createdAt])
  @@index([accountId, isRead])
}

model NotificationPreference {
  id         String  @id @default(cuid())
  accountId  String
  channel    String // in_app | web | push
  categoryId String?
  enabled    Boolean @default(true)

  account  AccountConnection @relation(fields: [accountId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  category Category?         @relation(fields: [categoryId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([accountId, channel, categoryId])
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// AI Assistant
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

model AssistantConversation {
  id        String    @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  accountId String?
  title     String?
  mode      String    @default("direct") // direct | thinking | suggest
  archived  Boolean   @default(false)
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())
  expiresAt DateTime?

  user     User               @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  account  AccountConnection? @relation(fields: [accountId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  messages AssistantMessage[]
  actions  AssistantAction[]

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  @@index([userId, archived])
}

model AssistantMessage {
  id             String   @id @default(cuid())
  conversationId String
  role           String // user | assistant | system | tool
  contentJson    String // JSON: structured content
  attachments    String   @default("[]") // JSON metadata refs
  sources        String   @default("[]") // JSON source refs
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())

  conversation AssistantConversation @relation(fields: [conversationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([conversationId, createdAt])
}

model AssistantAction {
  id             String    @id @default(cuid())
  conversationId String
  userId         String
  accountId      String?
  toolName       String
  inputSummary   String // JSON
  resultSummary  String? // JSON
  reversible     Boolean   @default(false)
  inversePayload String? // JSON
  status         String // pending | executed | failed | reverted
  errorMessage   String?
  createdAt      DateTime  @default(now())
  revertedAt     DateTime?

  conversation AssistantConversation @relation(fields: [conversationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  account      AccountConnection?    @relation(fields: [accountId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@index([conversationId, createdAt])
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Audit
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

model AuditEvent {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId        String?
  accountId     String?
  eventType     String
  targetType    String?
  targetId      String?
  sourceSurface String? // ui | ai | api | system
  actionId      String?
  metadata      String   @default("{}") // JSON
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())

  user    User?              @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  account AccountConnection? @relation(fields: [accountId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@index([accountId, createdAt])
  @@index([eventType])
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Drafts (compose)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

model Draft {
  id           String   @id @default(cuid())
  accountId    String
  toRecipients String   @default("[]")
  ccRecipients String   @default("[]")
  subject      String?
  body         String?
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([accountId, updatedAt])
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Saved Searches (filter presets)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

model SavedSearch {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  accountId String
  name      String
  filters   String // JSON-serialized SearchFilters
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([accountId])
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Email Templates (compose presets)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

model EmailTemplate {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  accountId String
  name      String
  subject   String
  body      String
  category  String   @default("general") // general | followup | request | announcement | custom
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([accountId])
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Conversation Intelligence — groups related emails/threads into conversations
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

model Conversation {
  id                 String    @id @default(cuid())
  accountId          String
  canonicalSubject   String
  status             String    @default("active") // active | awaiting_user | awaiting_other | follow_up_due | updated | resolved | archived
  followUpState      String    @default("none") // none | recommended | due | awaiting_response | resolved
  importance         String    @default("normal") // normal | important
  messageCount       Int       @default(0)
  participantSummary String    @default("[]") // JSON array of {email, name}
  latestMessageAt    DateTime?
  firstMessageAt     DateTime?
  aiSummary          String? // cached AI-generated summary
  aiSummaryAt        DateTime?
  createdAt          DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt          DateTime  @updatedAt

  threads   Thread[]
  overrides ConversationOverride[]

  @@index([accountId, latestMessageAt])
  @@index([accountId, status])
}

// Explicit relationship between two emails (REPLY_TO, FOLLOW_UP, etc.)
model EmailRelationship {
  id               String   @id @default(cuid())
  accountId        String
  fromEmailId      String
  toEmailId        String
  relationshipType String // reply_to | follow_up_to | reminder_of | clarification_of | update_to | forward_of | related_to | supersedes | references
  confidence       Float    @default(1.0) // 0.0–1.0
  reason           String   @default("") // "same Gmail thread", "same subject + participants", etc.
  createdAt        DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([accountId, fromEmailId])
  @@index([accountId, toEmailId])
}

// User corrections to conversation grouping (manual split/merge overrides)
model ConversationOverride {
  id             String   @id @default(cuid())
  accountId      String
  conversationId String
  emailId        String?
  threadId       String?
  overrideType   String // split | merge | exclude | include
  payload        String   @default("{}") // JSON
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())

  conversation Conversation @relation(fields: [conversationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([accountId, conversationId])
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Mailbox Scan & Sync Control Plane
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/// A saved scan configuration (reusable filter preset for Gmail ingestion).
model ScanConfiguration {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  accountId   String
  name        String
  description String?
  /// JSON: { scope, dateRange, senderFilter, subjectFilter, labelFilter, ... }
  config      String
  /// cron expression or "manual" or "incremental"
  schedule    String   @default("manual")
  enabled     Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([accountId])
}

/// A single scan job execution (manual or scheduled).
model ScanJob {
  id              String    @id @default(cuid())
  accountId       String
  configurationId String?
  /// manual | scheduled | incremental_sync | retry | initial_import
  jobType         String    @default("manual")
  /// queued | scanning | importing | classifying | completed | failed | cancelled | paused
  status          String    @default("queued")
  /// JSON: the full scan config snapshot at job creation time
  config          String
  /// JSON: { discovered, imported, updated, duplicates, failed, classified }
  results         String    @default("{}")
  /// JSON: { current, total, phase }
  progress        String    @default("{}")
  errorMessage    String?
  startedAt       DateTime?
  completedAt     DateTime?
  createdAt       DateTime  @default(now())

  @@index([accountId, createdAt])
  @@index([status])
}
